defective_pattern: Writing clumsy verbose Persian terms in table metric headers (e.g. مجموع مجذورات (SS)) instead of standard APA Latin symbols, or leaving raw English words scattered in Persian narrative.
why_defective: Clutters table presentation, violates concise APA table formatting standards, and ruins the formal purity of Persian scholarly text.
observed_symptoms: Table headers containing full Persian metric names
Raw English words appearing directly in Persian paragraphs
Absence of a table note defining statistical symbols
corrective_remedy: Use concise APA Latin symbols in table headers, define them in Persian in the note, and ensure pure Persian prose without raw English words.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Presence of verbose metric names in table header cells (e.g. 'میانگین', 'انحراف معیار') or presence of non-symbol English strings in body paragraphs.
